sources.prompt: Edit the supplied original top-down pixel-art sprite of a wounded Yugoslav partisan crawling prone. A single horizontal four-column sprite strip. One separate man per equal-size cell, with full silhouette visible, generous transparent padding. CONSTANT SCALE, identity, very simple solid low-resolution olive-and-khaki MS-DOS pixel art and thin charcoal contours from the reference. True overhead view, tiny square-pixel clusters, no soft shading or shadow. Each horizontal body has boots at the LEFT and head at the RIGHT without turning. Pose 1 exactly the reference. Pose 2 his supporting elbows start to give, right hand loosens and head dips. Pose 3 he rolls a little onto his side, front arm slips outward and fingers relax, one knee splays. Pose 4 a distinctly lifeless relaxed pose, head rests turned slightly sideways, one bent elbow and one lax arm and his legs rest asymmetrically. Same cap/skin color, same jacket trousers boots belt pouches. Keep hip at the center of each cell and same body length through all four cells. No scenery, no text, no props appearing, no impact, no gore, no drop shadow. True alpha transparent background.

Make a four-frame tiny low-color top-down pixel art death animation for the SINGLE olive uniform soldier in the supplied reference. Four figures total, equally spaced in a horizontal 4-column strip. Each man completely isolated on transparent background with generous padding. Four phases ONLY: exact upright overhead soldier pointing rifle northwest, then left leg folds as he drops to one knee, then torso rolling and unbraced, then lifeless prone final pose with boots visible toward southeast and head northwest, one limp arm on the ground and rifle dropped beside him. Anatomically plausible true overhead 90-degree projection. Consistent scale, helmet size and clothing, no blood, no text, no grids or props. Original game palette with sage and olive green uniform, dark olive helmet, black and tan rifle, beige hands, near-black outline, extremely simple flat chunky pixel art. The final flat body extends in length while the helmet remains the same size. No shadows or scenery. Transparent background throughout.
